name: Logitech MX Anywhere 3S (Bluetooth)
notes: 97-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface of a real Logitech MX Anywhere 3S, from a dump of the device: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/-/project/147/uploads/238615a0a9541eacd9281e2cb7725947/record.log. Bluetooth, so the descriptor is the device's whole HID report map. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
